rows.design_expectation: New send/receive durations are bounded by advertised policy and expired backing cannot fund a new grant/first external attempt; admitted liabilities may legitimately outlive their tree.
rows.required_proof: Exercise real send and receive exact minimum/maximum/skew bounds and expired first-attempt refusal, proving no source mutation on refusal and preserving previously admitted recoverable attempts.
rows.evidence_scope_warning: The original whole_id_pass flag applies only to the named original behavior and pinned execution; this design overlay does not extend it to unexecuted variants.

rows.behavior: Malicious prepared receive never completes while honest sender and unrelated sibling share backing.
rows.expected: Bounded resolution/progression; neither sender nor sibling stranded.
rows.demonstrated: A real ordinary sibling pays while a grant-only HTLC sibling waits, then later refunds.
rows.remaining_or_adaptation: Not the complete malicious prepared-receive plus honest-sender same-backing scenario.
rows.design_expectation: An unresolved HTLC blocks its own tree output, not every root at the same expiry; terminal sender recovery uses actual source/watchman evidence.
rows.required_proof: Create authentic uninitiated registered grant or real controlled held payment, leave its future deadline intact, confirm unrelated same-expiry ordinary payout, then genuinely revoke/settle and recover its own liability.
rows.evidence_scope_warning: The original whole_id_pass flag applies only to the named original behavior and pinned execution; this design overlay does not extend it to unexecuted variants.

rows.behavior: 101+ and >10,000 tiny coins to absent owner; 253+ distinct recipients and wallet fragmentation; repeated failed batch construction.
rows.expected: No starvation; output fees stable under retry; real standard weight/counts and rightful terminal outcomes.
rows.demonstrated: Small genuine mixed-tree progress and bounded12-wallet traffic execute.
rows.remaining_or_adaptation: No101+/10000-tiny-coin and253-recipient/fragmentation repeated-build capacity campaign; registration count is not coin count.
rows.design_expectation: Oversized ready groups first regroup; a single oversized output progresses through genuine signed tree transactions, conserving entitlements and real fees until terminal outputs fit.
rows.required_proof: Execute actual 101+/10,000 tiny coins and 253+ scripts where feasible, exact standard/V3 weight limits and signed progress, failed-build restart, no starvation and real canonical per-output fees; small manual split is partial only.
rows.evidence_scope_warning: The original whole_id_pass flag applies only to the named original behavior and pinned execution; this design overlay does not extend it to unexecuted variants.

rows.behavior: Abandon successive delegated rounds at acceptance/tree/forfeit/unlock boundaries.
rows.expected: Bounded lock/dependency cost; honest users continue; no old/new double obligation.
rows.demonstrated: Actual pre-forfeit cancellation and accepted lost-forfeit reply preserve state.
rows.remaining_or_adaptation: Successive delegated rounds at every boundary with measured lock/dependency costs remain.
rows.design_expectation: Nonbinding unfinished rounds are atomically cancellable while accepted forfeits remain binding; independent honest users progress and old/new principal is not duplicated.
rows.required_proof: Abandon successive real delegated rounds at each boundary, measure dependency/capital locks, race cancellation and accepted forfeits, then confirm final rightful discharges.
rows.evidence_scope_warning: The original whole_id_pass flag applies only to the named original behavior and pinned execution; this design overlay does not extend it to unexecuted variants.

rows.behavior: Bounded repeated authenticated/unauthenticated derivation requests; high-index hints and account-registration amplification.
rows.expected: Measured bounded DB/CPU work, no dense billion-child scan or unauthorized growth.
rows.demonstrated: Authenticated100/1000-account cases passed;10000 missing-mailbox positive search missed the120-second budget.
rows.remaining_or_adaptation: Wrong-mailbox10000 was not run; hints are obsolete; no production bound/capacity claim.
rows.design_expectation: No hints are required. Verified mailbox fast path and resumable per-pending-key full xpub fallback must have measured CPU/DB/storage/lock costs without treating unfinished search as no owner.
rows.required_proof: Measure actual absent/wrong/verified mailbox at 100/1,000/10,000 authenticated records, late keys and new registrations, restart/cursor continuity and unauthorized amplification; preserve the observed 10,000-record failure and prove any fix by rerun.
rows.evidence_scope_warning: The original whole_id_pass flag applies only to the named original behavior and pinned execution; this design overlay does not extend it to unexecuted variants.

rows.behavior: Malformed/truncated oversized hint/record, integer overflow, unsupported child encoding; supplemental fee input conflict and stale carrier callback variants.
rows.expected: Controlled refusal; no daemon failure or recipient amount change; orphan carrier recovered.
rows.demonstrated: Malformed record units and genuine fee-child replacement have separate evidence.
rows.remaining_or_adaptation: Hints/legacy carriers are removed; overflow, current fee-input conflict and stale callback/orphan cases need adaptation and actual runs.
rows.design_expectation: Current malformed record/amount/encoding is refused safely; immutable payout parent survives fee-child conflict/replacement, stale notifications and reorgs. No legacy carrier/hint API is assumed.
rows.required_proof: Inject malformed current RPC payloads and overflow boundaries, real confirmed-fee-input conflicts/child RBF and stale/orphan callbacks; independently prove unchanged recipient parent/amount and recoverable canonical allocation.
rows.evidence_scope_warning: The original whole_id_pass flag applies only to the named original behavior and pinned execution; this design overlay does not extend it to unexecuted variants.

accepted_corrections: Application-supplied standard payout script; external BIP84 is client integration.
Decision-boundary admission; no blanket pre-expiry margin.
Narrow new Lightning admission; existing liabilities may outlive backing.
Atomic cancellation of nonbinding unfinished exchanges.
Irreversible facts separated from rebuilt chain-derived ownership.
Permanent xpubs; no payer hints or per-key publication prerequisite.
design_baseline.original_provenance: The original id/behavior/expected/driver fields are preserved unchanged. Design expectations are a transparent overlay, not a replacement catalogue or inherited PASS.
